# crosswork_suppression_policies (Data Source)

This data source can read an alarm suppression policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_suppression_policies" "example" {
  id   = "cwtest-suppress"
  name = "cwtest-suppress"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `name` (String) Name of the policy, unique on the Crosswork cluster. The controller accepts letters, digits, `-` and `_`, up to 255 characters, and it cannot be changed

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `action` (String) What the policy suppresses, `suppressAlarm` for the alarms only (the events are still created) and `suppressEvent` for the alarms and the events
- `criteria` (String) Event types that the policy suppresses, written as `eventType in [A,B,C]` with the names of the event type catalog separated by a comma and no space
- `description` (String) Description of the policy
- `device_groups` (Set of String) Ids of the device groups whose devices the policy applies to. The controller accepts one group, or none
